#strategic-random has only you, Gideon and Nadia. The briefs will leave out finance figures and anything from DMs. #strategic-pod and #inc-vtg-hartford include people who aren't in #strategic-random (June, Mateo and Odile), so those two will be summarised in general terms.

I posted this as a reply in your thread. The job's next run time reads 2026-10-23 because it uses the machine's wall clock, not the simulation clock. I haven't checked that it will actually fire tomorrow.
